summary: Sandbach United kicked off their 2026/27 season in style with a thrilling 3-1 victory over league newcomers Wednesfield, with Bevan bagging a brace and showing some excellent movement throughout the match. The Ramblers dominated possession for large spells and looked sharp with their new-look starting XI containing five fresh faces who gelled quickly on the pitch. It was a solid start to the campaign at home, though the team will be keen to tighten up at the back after conceding a rather unfortunate deflected goal just before half-time.
